author: Gould, 1852
summary: 전국의 풀밭과 덤불, 관목 숲, 갈대밭에서 흔히 번식하는 텃새로, 수십 마리씩 무리를 지어 다닌다. 농가의 나무 울타리나 관목 숲 속에 둥지를 틀고 4~7월에 한배에 알 3~5개를 낳는다. 주로 곤충을 잡아먹고 거미도 먹는다. 국외에서는 중국과 미얀마 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: short, stubby bill with a pale tip

art.subject: Vinous-throated Parrotbill (Suthora webbiana), adult (sexes alike, plumage the same all year): crown, nape and sides of the head warm rufous-chestnut, the cheeks only slightly paler; throat and breast pinkish-buff to vinaceous with faint fine darker streaks on the throat; belly paler olive-buff; back, rump and tail warm greyish-brown; wings brown with rufous-chestnut edges to the coverts and flight feathers, forming a rufous wing panel; tiny, very deep, parrot-like bill, grey with a paler tip; dark eye.
art.pose: clinging sideways to a dry reed stem with the tail cocked, one of a busy flock moving through the reeds
art.scene: Korean field edge in winter: dry common reeds and low shrubs beside a stream, pale low sunlight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view clinging to a reed stem: tiny deep bill, grey with a paler tip; rufous-chestnut crown and nape; pinkish-buff throat and breast; warm brown back; rufous panel on the folded wing; paler buff belly; long graduated tail
adult, side view perched on a twig with the tail held straight: the same plumage, showing the long wedge-shaped tail and the rufous wing panel clearly
art.build: Tiny, long-tailed songbird, about the size of a Long-tailed Tit, with a round, plump body. Large round head with no crest; the crown feathers lie flat. No visible neck. Bill tiny, very short and deep with a curved culmen, like a miniature parrot's, much shorter than the head. Legs short and strong for clinging to stems. Wings short and rounded; at rest they reach only the base of the tail. Tail long, about as long as the body, graduated. Moves in noisy, restless flocks through reeds, grass and shrubs, flying weakly from bush to bush.
avoid: Do not paint a slender pointed bill; the bill is tiny, deep and parrot-like.
Do not paint a black eye-stripe or a white head; that is Long-tailed Tit.
Do not paint grey or olive tones; the bird is warm brown, rufous and pinkish-buff.
Do not paint a short tail.
